V1.name: sniper
V1.rule: control: upper third -> CALL, lower third + calm RV20 -> PUT

V2.name: always-on
V2.rule: V1 signal; middle third trades toward nearer range edge

V3.name: extremes
V3.rule: outer quarters only: pos>=0.75 CALL, pos<=0.25 PUT

V4.name: patient
V4.rule: identical to V1, entry delayed to 09:30:10 ET

V5.name: reversal
V5.rule: extreme deciles faded: pos>=0.90 PUT, pos<=0.10 CALL
